name: LOOP With One Diesel Failure
description: A loss of off-site power is followed by the failure of emergency diesel generator B to start. Only train A is available to power essential loads; the operator observes the degraded but stable decay-heat removal configuration.
briefing: Off-site power is lost at t+15 s. Diesel B fails to start at t+16 s. Confirm diesel A carries the essential bus, monitor battery charge, and keep the plant stable on one train.
learning_objectives: Redundancy and the single-failure criterion in emergency power
How to distinguish an equipment (diesel) failure from an instrument failure
Battery endurance and load shedding when AC power is degraded

events.label: Emergency diesel generator B fails to start
